items.source: if there is one row with one column, convert that value to this converter's type if possible or throw,

马修·T·亚当斯，马克·帕卢赫

items.source: Convenient converter that can be used to convert a single-row-single-column, single-row-multi-column, or multi-row ResultSet into the given value of a given type. The majority of the expected usage is to convert a single-row-single-column result set into the target type.
items.translation: 这是一个便捷的转换器，可用于将单行单列、单行多列或多行的 ResultSet 转换为指定类型的给定值。其主要的预期用途是将单行单列的结果集转换为目标类型。

items.source:
• 如果存在一行一列，则尝试将该值转换为当前转换器的类型；若无法转换，则抛出异常。
  • 否则，如果存在一行包含多个列，则尝试将这些列转换为该转换器的类型；若无法转换，则抛出异常。
  • 否则，由于存在多行，将这些行转换为该转换器的类型，或抛出异常。
items.translation:
• If there is a single row and column, attempt to convert the value to the type of the current converter; if conversion fails, throw an exception.
  • Otherwise, if there is a single row with multiple columns, attempt to convert those columns to the type of the converter; if conversion fails, throw an exception.
  • Otherwise, since there are multiple rows, convert these rows to the type of the converter, or throw an exception.
